desc_en: Paola Antonelli's MoMA exhibition on how designers translate advances in science into objects; its bio section introduced tissue-engineered, synthetic-biology and animal-centred speculative design, much of it from the RCA Design Interactions programme.
desc_zh: Paola Antonelli 在 MoMA 策划的展览，关注设计师如何把科学进展转化为物件；其中的生物部分首次集中展示了组织工程、合成生物学和以动物为中心的思辨设计，许多来自皇家艺术学院 Design Interactions 专业。

desc_en: The XXII Triennale di Milano, curated by Paola Antonelli, on restorative design: objects and systems that repair the bonds between humans and their environments, from bio-based materials to designs made with and for other species.
desc_zh: 第 22 届米兰三年展，由 Paola Antonelli 策展，主题是“修复性设计”：修复人与环境之间联系的物件和系统，从生物基材料到与其他物种一起、为其他物种所做的设计。

desc_en: Cooper Hewitt's sixth design triennial, co-organised with Cube design museum, showing 62 teams who collaborate with nature to understand, remediate, simulate, salvage, facilitate, augment and nurture it.
desc_zh: 库珀-休伊特第六届设计三年展，与荷兰 Cube 设计博物馆联合举办，展出 62 个与自然合作的团队，按理解、修复、模拟、回收、促进、增强和培育等策略组织。

desc_en: The first major museum exhibition on more-than-human design, curated by Rebecca Lewin and Justin McGuirk with Future Observatory: over 140 works in three sections (Being Landscape, Making with the World, Shifting Perspective) on designing with and for other species.
desc_zh: 第一个以“超越人类的设计”为主题的大型博物馆展览，由 Rebecca Lewin 与 Justin McGuirk 联合 Future Observatory 策划：140 多件作品分为“成为景观”“与世界共同制作”“转换视角”三部分，讨论如何与其他物种一起、为其他物种设计。

en: Alive / En Vie: New Design Frontiers (Espace Fondation EDF 2013)
zh: 《Alive / En Vie：设计的新边界》（巴黎 Espace Fondation EDF 2013）
desc_en: Carole Collet's Paris exhibition of about 30 designers and architects working with living systems, grouped by how they relate to nature: as model, co-worker, reprogrammed organism, hybrid or provocation.
desc_zh: Carole Collet 在巴黎策划的展览，约 30 位设计师和建筑师展示与生命系统合作的作品，按他们与自然的关系分组：把自然当作模型、同事、被重编程的生物、混合体或挑衅对象。

en: Science Gallery bio shows (GROW YOUR OWN... 2013 and after)
zh: Science Gallery 生物主题展（2013《GROW YOUR OWN...》及之后）
desc_en: Science Gallery Dublin's GROW YOUR OWN... (2013), curated by Alexandra Daisy Ginsberg, Anthony Dunne, Paul Freemont, Cathal Garvey and Michael John Gorman, set synthetic-biology art and design around a working community biolab.
desc_zh: 都柏林 Science Gallery 的《GROW YOUR OWN...》（2013）由 Alexandra Daisy Ginsberg、Anthony Dunne、Paul Freemont、Cathal Garvey 和 Michael John Gorman 策展，把合成生物学相关的艺术与设计围绕一个真正运作的社区生物实验室展开。

en: Mushrooms: The Art, Design and Future of Fungi (Somerset House 2020)
zh: 《蘑菇：真菌的艺术、设计与未来》（伦敦萨默塞特宫 2020）
desc_en: Francesca Gavin's show of over 40 artists, designers and musicians; its 'Fungal Futures' room gathered designers growing buildings, lamps, shoes, textiles and burial suits from mycelium.
desc_zh: Francesca Gavin 策划、汇集 40 多位艺术家、设计师和音乐人的展览；其中“真菌未来”展厅集中展示了用菌丝体长出建筑、灯具、鞋、织物和寿衣的设计师。

zh: 《La Fabrique du vivant（生命的制造）》（蓬皮杜中心 2019）
desc_en: The third Mutations / Créations exhibition, curated by Marie-Ange Brayer and Olivier Zeitoun: about 100 projects by some 50 artists, designers and architects working with living matter, several of which grew or decayed during the show.
desc_zh: 第三届 Mutations / Créations 展，由 Marie-Ange Brayer 与 Olivier Zeitoun 策划：约 50 位艺术家、设计师和建筑师的约 100 个与生命物质合作的项目，其中不少在展期内持续生长或衰变。

en: Biodesign exhibitions curated by William Myers (Rotterdam 2013, RISD 2018)
zh: William Myers 策划的 Biodesign 展（鹿特丹 2013、罗德岛设计学院 2018）
desc_en: Exhibitions built around William Myers' book Biodesign: at Het Nieuwe Instituut, Rotterdam (2013-14) and 'Biodesign: From Inspiration to Integration' at the RISD Nature Lab (2018), showing designers and artists who use living organisms as working parts of their projects.
desc_zh: 围绕 William Myers 的著作《Biodesign》展开的展览：鹿特丹 Het Nieuwe Instituut（2013–14）以及罗德岛设计学院 Nature Lab 的《Biodesign: From Inspiration to Integration》（2018），展示把活的生物当作作品工作部件的设计师和艺术家。

desc_en: A non-profit art space in Berlin-Wedding, run by Regine Rapp and Christian de Lutz, whose exhibition series since 2014 ([micro]biologies, Nonhuman Subjectivities, Nonhuman Agents, Mind the Fungi) show bio art and more-than-human research.
desc_zh: 柏林 Wedding 区的非营利艺术空间，由 Regine Rapp 和 Christian de Lutz 主持，自 2014 年起以系列展览（[micro]biologies、Nonhuman Subjectivities、Nonhuman Agents、Mind the Fungi）持续展示生物艺术与超越人类的研究。

desc_en: Kapelica Gallery, part of the Kersnikova Institute in Ljubljana and directed by Jurij Krpan, has produced and shown bio art, tissue culture and interspecies works since the 1990s, many as premieres by Slovenian artists.
desc_zh: Kapelica 画廊隶属卢布尔雅那的 Kersnikova 研究所，由 Jurij Krpan 主持，自 1990 年代起制作并展出生物艺术、组织培养和跨物种作品，其中许多是斯洛文尼亚艺术家的首展。

zh: SymbioticA 驻留项目（西澳大学）
desc_en: SymbioticA, founded in 2000 by Oron Catts, Ionat Zurr and Stuart Bunt at the University of Western Australia, was the first research lab where artists work hands-on with tissue culture and life science methods. The works here were made there in residence.
desc_zh: SymbioticA 由 Oron Catts、Ionat Zurr 和 Stuart Bunt 于 2000 年在西澳大学创立，是第一个让艺术家亲手使用组织培养和生命科学方法的研究实验室。这里的作品都在该处驻留期间完成。

desc_en: Waag Futurelab's Open Wetlab in Amsterdam hosts bio art residencies, the BioHack Academy and the European project 'Trust Me, I'm an Artist', in which artists present living artworks to ethics committees in public.
desc_zh: 阿姆斯特丹 Waag Futurelab 的 Open Wetlab 举办生物艺术驻留、BioHack Academy 和欧洲项目“Trust Me, I'm an Artist”，后者让艺术家当众向伦理委员会提交活体艺术作品方案。

desc_en: A Nordic art-and-science programme led by the Bioart Society on 'hybrid ecologies', with exhibitions in 2016 at Kunsthall Grenland, Nikolaj Kunsthal and Forum Box showing works on cloned trees, insects, animals and plastic-eating organisms.
desc_zh: 由 Bioart Society 主导的北欧艺术与科学项目，主题为“混合生态”，2016 年在 Kunsthall Grenland、Nikolaj Kunsthal 和 Forum Box 展出，作品涉及克隆树、昆虫、动物和能吃塑料的生物。

en: How Will We Live Together? (Venice Architecture Biennale 2021)
zh: 《How Will We Live Together?》（2021 威尼斯建筑双年展）
desc_en: The 17th Venice Architecture Biennale, curated by Hashim Sarkis, whose 'Among Diverse Beings' and 'As New Households' sections included microbial, fungal, bird and algae architectures.
desc_zh: 第 17 届威尼斯建筑双年展，由 Hashim Sarkis 策展，其中“Among Diverse Beings”与“As New Households”等单元收录了以微生物、真菌、鸟类和藻类为对象的建筑。

desc_en: A 'thought exhibition' by Bruno Latour and Peter Weibel at ZKM Karlsruhe (2020–22) on the thin living layer of the Earth, with works that observe forests, swamps, insects and corals.
desc_zh: Bruno Latour 与 Peter Weibel 在 ZKM 卡尔斯鲁厄策划的“思想展览”（2020–22），关注地球表面薄薄的生命层，作品观察森林、沼泽、昆虫和珊瑚。

desc_en: Annual summit on grown materials founded by Suzanne Lee in 2014 (New York, London, Paris), where start-ups and designers show biofabricated materials and products in talks and a curated Design Lab.
desc_zh: Suzanne Lee 于 2014 年创办的生长材料年度峰会（纽约、伦敦、巴黎），初创公司和设计师在演讲和策划的 Design Lab 中展示生物制造的材料与产品。

desc_en: The art-science journal founded in 1968, where bio-artists describe their own works and lab protocols, from tissue-culture sculpture and transgenic art to algae collectives and cell-based installations.
desc_zh: 创刊于 1968 年的艺术与科学期刊，生物艺术家在这里介绍自己的作品和实验流程，从组织培养雕塑、转基因艺术到藻类艺术团体和细胞装置。

desc_en: Open-access Cambridge University Press journal launched in 2022 for biodesign research, publishing grown architecture, mycelium and bacterial materials, living textiles and habitat design projects with their methods.
desc_zh: 剑桥大学出版社于 2022 年创办的开放获取生物设计期刊，发表生长建筑、菌丝体与细菌材料、活体纺织品和栖息地设计等项目及其方法。

en: Dutch Design Week: bio-based and living-material shows
zh: 荷兰设计周：生物基与活体材料展
desc_en: Eindhoven's annual design week, where the Design Academy Eindhoven Graduation Show, Biobased Creations, BioArt Laboratories and other programmes present grown, microbial and waste-stream materials every October.
desc_zh: 埃因霍温一年一度的设计周；每年十月，埃因霍温设计学院毕业展、Biobased Creations、BioArt Laboratories 等项目在这里展示生长材料、微生物材料和废料再生材料。

desc_en: The juried art exhibition of the ACM SIGGRAPH computer graphics conferences, which since the 1990s has included works built with living plants, bacteria and fermentation alongside digital art.
desc_zh: ACM SIGGRAPH 计算机图形学大会的评审制艺术展；自 1990 年代起，除数字艺术外也展出以活体植物、细菌和发酵为材料的作品。

en: Designing with living organisms at ACM HCI venues (CHI, DIS, TEI, UIST, C&C)
zh: ACM 人机交互会议中的“与活体生物一起设计”（CHI、DIS、TEI、UIST、C&C）
desc_en: Bio design and biohybrid interaction papers published at ACM CHI, DIS, TEI, UIST and Creativity & Cognition, where HCI researchers have built interfaces, displays and devices with microbes, algae, fungi, slime moulds and plants since the mid-2000s.
desc_zh: 发表在 ACM CHI、DIS、TEI、UIST 和 Creativity & Cognition 上的生物设计与生物混合交互论文；自 2000 年代中期以来，人机交互研究者在这些会议上用微生物、藻类、真菌、黏菌和植物制作界面、显示器和设备。
